name: Accordion
description: Expandable panel navigation with single or multiple open items

items.description: Ordered section definitions with unique string values.

icon.description: Default decorative icon at the start of each trigger; item.icon overrides it.

expandedIds.description: Controlled section values; absent items are retained for asynchronous lists.

defaultExpandedIds.description: Initial uncontrolled section values; later changes are ignored.

multiple.description: Allow multiple open sections; false displays the first available expanded value.

collapsible.description: Allow users to collapse the last visible open section; does not auto-open a section.

disabled.description: Disable all disclosure triggers; panel contents keep their own interactivity.

headingLevel.description: Heading level for section triggers in the containing document.

behavior.stateModel: Machine stores expandedIds and supports controlled or uncontrolled expansion.
behavior.multiple: By default, opening one item keeps already open items expanded. Set multiple=false to force single-open behavior.
behavior.collapsible: When collapsible=false, the last open item cannot be closed by toggling it.

notes: Triggers are native buttons; content panels are hidden when collapsed.
Accordion intentionally uses shared control geometry and motion tokens instead of accordion-local size or timing tokens.
Item icons reuse Button icon semantics: string names resolve through Icon, React nodes render directly, and left-icon triggers use --uf-control-pad-icon.
Content panels keep full slot width so nested controls retain their own system insets and full-width behavior.
Trigger labels and content strings route through Text; nested action content should remain Face UI or UF components.

whenToUse: Long content that needs progressive disclosure
whenNotToUse: Simple show/hide toggle without grouped content
